correctness.rationale: For a geometric window, each lag |a|<=m has a nonzero ambiguity overlap at every modulation (ratio modulus four); every other lag has disjoint support. Fourier inversion therefore recovers exactly edges of the induced support graph; phase retrieval for one window is equivalent to connectivity. I independently enumerated all 16383 nonempty 14-bit support masks at bandwidth four: 560 disconnected, grouped into 42 translation orbits. For all 42x42 pairs of disconnected supports, exact elimination of the (T^c,S) Fourier restriction over F_1009 with primitive 14th root 904 had full column rank. A nonzero reduced minor proves the corresponding cyclotomic minor nonzero over C, so no nonzero signal can have both time and Fourier disconnected supports. At m=3, exact rank checks on a 3x4 seventh-root matrix and four augmented 4x4 matrices yield a nonzero-support kernel with time support {0,2,8,10} and Fourier support {0,1,2,3,7,8,9,10}; both bandwidth-three graphs disconnect. Monotonicity handles all m<=3 and 5,6. This is a finite exhaustive certificate with an all-signal analytic rank reduction, not a mere signal sample.
